why: In each row, put the first two figures on top of each other: lines that appear in both cancel out, the rest stay. Row 2: up+down and down+right give up+right (the down line cancels). Row 3: up line + right line gives a dot with an up line and a right line, which is option 1. Option 3 has left and right lines, so it is wrong.
trick: In a 3x3 grid with lines being added, test "1st + 2nd = 3rd" and check if same lines cancel.
